methodology.structural_coverage: A published Nursing lesson section counts only when body has >=350 trimmed characters, concept id is explicit, and section or inherited lesson instructional source IDs resolve in storage/sources.json. Count each board/concept placement once. This is a screening measure, not academic sufficiency/approval.
methodology.exact_mapping: A relationship counts only when canonical active question is Nursing, and study-question-links has both lesson_id and section_id. Pending state is not approval.
methodology.global_basis: 687 current unique board/concept placement pairs from storage/board-concept-coverage.json; B703-reported 646 denominator is not reproduced at this HEAD.

summary.prior_denominator_reconciliation: The B703 report denominator 646 does not match this HEAD: storage/board-concept-coverage.json contains 687 unique board/concept pairs and 606 distinct concept IDs. Recomputed method yields 400 covered/687 placements. Do not reuse 646 without a derivation.
